question: Minnesota Governor Republican Primary Winner
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for Governor of Minnesota, scheduled to take place on August 11, 2026. Resolution will be based on the overall winner of the primary, including any potential second round or run-off.

If no 2026 Minnesota Gubernatorial Republican Primary takes place, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement of the results from the Minnesota Republican Party; however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I found articles dated after July 25, 2026 (the primary results and later market prices). I've left them out, as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the first official results announcement from the Minnesota Republican Party, or on a strong consensus of credible reporting. No URL is given. Official counts come from the Minnesota Secretary of State. The primary is August 11, 2026, so as of July 25 no results exist.
- 2026-06-02: The candidate filing period closed. [MN SOS](https://www.sos.mn.gov/about-the-office/news-room/candidate-filing-period-now-open/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The race is a three-way contest.
- 2026-06-03: Seven Republican tickets filed: Loner Blue, Lisa Demuth (running mate Ryan Wilson), Raul Estrada, John Krhin, Mike Lindell (running mate Phillip Parrish), Ross Nova and Kendall Qualls (running mate Brian Nicholson). Scott Jensen, Jeff Johnson, Patrick Knight and Brad Kohler are not on the filed list. [KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/06/03/who-filed-run-minnesota-governor/)
- 2026-02-09: Scott Jensen left the governor's race to run for state auditor. He had about 6-7% in the caucus straw poll. [MPR](https://www.mprnews.org/story/2026/02/09/jensen-drops-out-gop-race-minnesota-governor-run-state-auditor)
- 2026-02-09 (approximate): Jeff Johnson suspended his campaign after a family tragedy, according to search snippets. I could not open the source article to confirm the date.
- Knight was still campaigning on 2026-05-24 ([KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/05/24/one-on-one-with-minnesota-gubernatorial-candidate-patrick-knight/)), but he did not file. I found no article about Kohler withdrawing, but he is also not on the filed list.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-07-21 ("three weeks" before the primary): KSTP/SurveyUSA had Lindell at 35% (up 8 points), Demuth about 26% (up 4), Qualls 11% and 22% undecided. Lindell's gain followed Trump's endorsement. [KSTP](https://kstp.com/kstp-news/top-news/kstp-surveyusa-poll-lindell-tafoya-increase-their-election-leads-craig-ellison-margins-shrink/)
- 2026-07-15: Trump endorsed Lindell on Truth Social. Qualls answered that the race "won't be won by national endorsements." [WAFB/Gray](https://www.wafb.com/2026/07/15/donald-trump-endorses-pillow-man-mike-lindell-minnesota-governor/); [Fox 9](https://www.fox9.com/news/trump-endorses-mike-lindell-minnesota-governor)
- About 2026-06 (the report says "last month"): Lindell settled the Dominion defamation suit. He is appealing the Coomer verdict, and Smartmatic won summary judgment against him in 2025. [WAFB/Gray](https://www.wafb.com/2026/07/15/donald-trump-endorses-pillow-man-mike-lindell-minnesota-governor/)
- 2026-06-21: Demuth and Qualls were both seeking Trump's endorsement. Cash on hand: Demuth $544K, Qualls $100K. A poll suggested Demuth runs best against Klobuchar, though the article gave no figures. [Valley News Live](https://www.valleynewslive.com/2026/06/22/lisa-demuth-kendall-qualls-seek-presidents-endorsement-ahead-august-primary/)
- 2026-06 (fielded June 11-16): KSTP/SurveyUSA had Lindell 27%, Demuth 22%, Qualls 17%, with about a quarter undecided. [KSTP](https://kstp.com/?p=3955731)
- 2026-05-30: Qualls won the state GOP convention endorsement over Demuth after 10 ballots in Duluth. Demuth and Lindell went on to the primary anyway. [KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/05/30/update-kendall-qualls-secures-gop-endorsement-mn-governor-after-10-ballots/)
- 2026-02 (precinct caucus straw poll): Demuth led with about 32%. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/demuth-leads-minnesota-gop-gubernatorial-054520308.html)
- 2025-12-15: Qualls won an earlier state party straw poll. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/local/twin-cities/2025/12/15/minnesota-governor-republican-straw-poll-results)

## 4. Base rates
- Minnesota GOP convention endorsees have often lost contested primaries. In 2010 Tom Emmer won both. In 2018 Jeff Johnson was endorsed and beat Tim Pawlenty. In 1994 Arne Carlson beat endorsee Allen Quist. That is a mixed record, which I recalled from memory rather than a source I checked.
- In 2026 the endorsee, Qualls, polls third, has the least cash of the three and is falling (17% to 11%).
- Trump-endorsed candidates usually win Republican primaries, but well-funded establishment candidates have sometimes won anyway.
- SurveyUSA primary polls have large undecided shares (about 21-25%) and a single-digit Lindell lead, so polling error at that size is common in primaries.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-19: A prediction.com/PredictionHunt headline said "Demuth Hits 56% in Minnesota GOP Governor Race." The page returned HTTP 410, so I could not confirm the platform or the other candidates' prices. [link](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/demuth-hits-56-in-minnesota-gop-governor-race-jul-19-2026)
- A Kalshi news headline said "Minnesota governor primary odds: Demuth favored over Lindell." I could not confirm its date. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/minnesota-governor-primary-odds-demuth-favored-over-lindell)
- Aggregator snippets with unclear timestamps put Lindell at 64-71% on Polymarket after the July 15 endorsement. Treat these as unreliable.
- Polymarket market page: [link](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/minnesota-governor-republican-primary-winner/)
- Taken together, markets around July 19-25 appear split between Demuth and Lindell.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Another KSTP/SurveyUSA poll is likely before the primary.
- Debates, if any are held.
- Further Trump involvement, such as a rally or more posts.
- Campaign finance reports and ad spending, where Demuth has the cash advantage.
- Whether Qualls stays in, or his voters move to Demuth.
- Early voting is under way (it began in late June). Then the August 11 primary itself.
- If the margin is close, the canvass and possible recount rules apply. Minnesota pays for a recount only if the margin is 0.25% or less.
